With src/ on path the suite is 25/0. Load-bearing: a reviewer trusting bare-pytest would falsely block correct landed work. Surfaced as mechanism_observation during lead-vusv review. Fix: canonical pour/install must guarantee an EDITABLE install, not a frozen wheel copy. NOTE: likely canonical-managed/infra (not BC-local-code fixable in place per CLAUDE.md) — may need routing to shopsystem-templates.
notes: Blocked on canonical/cross-shop routing: durable fix is an EDITABLE install in the shopsystem-templates pour process, not BC-local src/ code (CLAUDE.md forbids in-place canonical edits). close_reason: Resolved by lead-hk2a: the conftest editable-install/stale-wheel guard (merge d5e1290, scenarios 1db84538be1f0878 + 4ba1ddd8fc25a2eb) now aborts collection fast with a 'pip install -e .' remediation when a stale non-editable wheel shadows src/, replacing the spurious ModuleNotFoundError false-block this bead named.
